{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (only 2 rows)
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the exact values as computed
print('Mean flipper length for Adelie:', mean_flipper_by_species['Adelie'])
print('Mean flipper length for Chinstrap:', mean_flipper_by_species['Chinstrap'])
print('Mean flipper length for Gentoo:', mean_flipper_by_species['Gentoo'])
print('Species with highest mean flipper length:', mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax())"}
